answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the forge graph is rebuilt each epoch, the garden merge is applied at settlement and the voyage audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 36 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 10 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
